title: Sources: Z.ai's 3T-parameter flagship GLM-5.5 missed its November release and could be delayed to Q1 2027 or later due to US rules and labs' distillation curbs (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: Z.ai's 3T-parameter flagship GLM-5.5 missed its November release and could be delayed to Q1 2027 or later due to US rules and labs' distillation curbs — China's Z.AI has fallen behind schedule on its next flagship AI model, while rival Moonshot AI expects the interval between major releases …
